# STY011 `mixed-scalar-array-declaration`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

One declaration statement declares both scalars and arrays.

## Why

`real :: x, y(3)` hides the array among scalars: the shape is easy to miss when reading the
declaration list. Declare arrays and scalars in separate statements.

## Reported

```fortran
real :: x, y(3)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real :: x
real :: y(3)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[STY011] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = STY011` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `S262` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
